title: Scan Claude skills before you install
caption:
Stop. Don't install that Claude skill yet. 🛑

A skill can hide malicious code, prompt injection, even data theft. SkillSpector, a free open-source tool from NVIDIA, scans it before you install it and flags the risks. An LLM key is optional for deeper checks.
Apache-2.0 license. Not affiliated with this project or with Claude.

Comment SCAN and I'll send you the link. Tag a friend who installs everything. Follow @StickMindR8!

#claudecode #aisecurity #aitools #opensource #reelsinstagram
